source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def components(grid, color):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); result=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            result.append(cells)
    return result

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    edge=[]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{bg}:
        for cells in components(grid,color):
            if any(r==0 or c==0 or r==h-1 or c==w-1 for r,c in cells):
                rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
                bh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; bw=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
                edge.append((bh*bw,len(cells),color,cells,bh,bw))
    if not edge: return out
    _,_,source_color,source,sh,sw=max(edge,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    target_color=max((c for c in counts if c not in (bg,source_color)),key=lambda c:counts[c],default=None)
    if target_color is None: return out
    want_h,want_w=sh/2,sw/2
    cand=[]
    for cells in components(grid,target_color):
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        ch=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; cw=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        direct=abs(ch-want_h)+abs(cw-want_w)
        rotated=abs(ch-want_w)+abs(cw-want_h)
        score=min(direct,rotated)
        cand.append((score,-len(cells),cells))
    if cand:
        _,_,chosen=min(cand,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
        for r,c in chosen: out[r][c]=source_color
    return out
'''
